_comment: Dated Mataro Bus diversions and stop closures (plan step 5.2), shown as notices with source 'calendar' while their window is open. Times are Europe/Madrid local 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'; end is exclusive. lines: Mataro Bus line ids ('1'..'8'); an empty list makes a general notice. stops: Mataro Bus stop ids (data/cities/mataro/mataro_paradas.json) closed during the window, shown as 'Desviada'; leave it empty when the notice does not name them. confidence: 'reported' (from a search summary of the official notice) or 'verified' (read on the official page). Add each year's events from mataro.cat/ca/actualitat/avisos; see OPERATIONS.md, 'Dated diversions'.

events.title: Les Santes: Dissantes
events.description: Dissabte de Dissantes, de les 19:00 fins a les 08:00 de l'endemà: les línies L1, L2, L4, L6 i L8 es desvien per la plaça d'Espanya.

events.title: Les Santes: Gegantada
events.description: Divendres de la Gegantada, de 19:30 a 21:30: les línies L3 i L8 es desvien pel Camí Ral.

events.title: Les Santes: Barram i Repicada
events.description: Diumenge del Barram i la Repicada, de 12:00 a 14:30: les línies L1 i L4 es desvien.

events.title: Les Santes: cercavila De parranda
events.description: Diumenge, des de les 17:00 i fins que acabi la cercavila De parranda (l'hora de fi no es va publicar): les línies L1 i L4 es desvien.

events.title: Les Santes: castell de focs
events.description: Nit del castell de focs, de 22:00 a 01:00: l'avinguda del Maresme està tallada i hi pot haver desviaments a les línies que hi passen.

yearlyChecklist: Fira a Mataró (local holiday, late May): check mataro.cat avisos for diversions.
Les Santes (about 18-29 July; notice published mid-July): Dissantes, Gegantada, Barram, Nit Boja, castell de focs; also Bus Focs lines 10-12 (shown live by app/specialservice.go).
Tots Sants (1 November): Cementiri de Les Valls stop and any reinforcement.
Christmas, Cap d'Any and Reis (24 December to 6 January): early finishes and the Cavalcada de Reis diversions (5 January).
